title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2605.26032v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. Both natural images and critical physical systems exhibit scale invariance, and we leverage it to design a forward process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise, making scale an explicit coordinate of the diffusion dynamics. translated_title: 万物于每一尺度：具备连续超分辨率的尺度不变扩散模型
translated_abstract: 从噪声中创建图像是图像生成；从粗糙输入中重建精细细节是超分辨率。尽管二者在实际应用中有所不同，但都可以理解为对跨尺度信息损失的逆转。我们提出了 SKILD——一种尺度不变的 K 空间图像学习扩散模型，它在单一的无条件框架内统一了图像生成与连续超分辨率。自然图像与临界物理系统均表现出尺度不变性，我们利用这一特性设计了一个前向过程，该过程将图像内容从细尺度到粗尺度逐步衰减，同时注入与频谱匹配的高斯噪声，从而使尺度成为扩散动力学的一个显式坐标。同一个经过训练的逆向过程仅需改变起始时间步即可执行生成或连续超分辨率：无需任务特定的架构，无需条件分支……
tldr: 提出尺度不变的扩散模型 SKILD，将图像生成与连续超分辨率统一在单一无条件框架中，仅通过改变起始时间步即可在两种任务间切换。
en_tdlr: SKILD, a scale-invariant diffusion model, unifies image generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework, switching between tasks merely by varying the starting timestep.
